exposure: history of upper respiratory tract infection episodes
pattern of rapid post-natal weight gain
cohort: The study involved 32 neonates born between December 2019 and December 2020 at Hospital Sant Joan de Deu in Barcelona, Spain.
finding: The nasopharyngeal microbiota composition stabilized by 12 months of age during the COVID-19 period, and rapid post-natal weight gain was associated with specific differences in microbiota composition, including overrepresentation of beneficial bacteria and underrepresentation of potential pathogens, with enhanced metabolic activity.
